rationale: The assistant correctly identified the hidden truth in one turn: 'Most ovens have a dedicated cooling fan that runs after you switch off' and 'It is only a fault if the fan continues running indefinitely even when the oven is completely cold'. It gave the right abnormal-case boundary ('loud grinding noises', running indefinitely) and recommended no parts or DIY. It did not ask the customer to confirm the fan eventually stops or tell them who to contact if it never does, so the next-step guidance is slightly thin, but the homeowner is well served and reassured without false certainty.
